title: Lights Out
intro: The last thing before sleep, done in your bedroom with the lights already low and nothing planned afterwards.

No box breathing tonight. Counting four sides of a box keeps a part of you alert, which is what you want before a match and the opposite of what you want now. Long exhales only, and falling asleep during it means it worked.

exercises.name: Legs Up the Wall
exercises.note: Go straight to bed after this — going back to a screen undoes it.

good: Heels up the wall or the headboard, arms out wide
Hug both knees in gently and rock slowly side to side
Just enough movement to let the lower back let go

exercises.name: Extended Exhale Breathing
exercises.note: If you lose count, start again; if you fall asleep, good.

good: Lying down, in through the nose for four, out for eight
Only the hand on your belly should move
bad: Straining for the full eight — shorten to six and keep it easy
